description: NIH grant search — Search NIH-funded research projects (NIH RePORTER) by topic q=, institution org= and/or investigator pi=, for fiscal years years= (comma list, default current and previous federal FY). Returns total matches, project list (project number, title, fiscal year, award amount, organization and location, PIs, institute, activity code, new vs continuing, start/end, abstract excerpt, RePORTER link) plus funding aggregates over the top 100 matches: top NIH institutes, top organizations and top activity codes by dollars. Optional sort=relevance|amount|date and limit= (1-50, default 10). Useful for competitive research, academic partnership scouting, biotech due diligence and grant writing. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: research_nih_grants
